text:
Ana: @payroll-team quick question — Sam (joined as contractor Oct 2024) converted to full-time on 2026-02-15 and relocated to UK 2026-02-01. Their contractor invoices were paid to US bank. On the new paystub I see both 'UK PAYE' and 'US FED' listed. Is that expected? Sam says net pay is very low :grimacing:

payroll-bot: Ticket PR-4821 created — assign to ben-payroll

ben-payroll: looking into it. Can you confirm Sam's home address in the system and whether they submitted a P45 or UK payroll docs?

Ana: Sam provided passport + UK visa and completed UK starter checklist. Address updated in HRIS last week, but payroll country might still be US (I think)

ben-payroll: likely root cause: employee record country code = US so payroll engine applied US federal withholding while payroll country calculations also applied UK PAYE. I'll check the onboarding mappings and bank account country. If they were previously contractor in US, we might have dual tax entries. Give me 30m.

marta: Annotating — need residency evidence to confirm UK tax residency start date. If tax residency started before conversion we should stop US withholdings and run an adjustment / refund for duplicate withholdings.

ben-payroll: confirmed in system: `payroll_country=GB`, tax_profile shows `legacy_contractor_us=true` and Federal withholding still active. I'll update payroll config to zero US federal for Sam for payrun 2026-02-28 and process a correction for 2026-02-15 pay. Will need to run manual reclaim of overwithheld US tax via payroll adjustments.

Ana: Thanks. What docs should Sam expect for the correction? Any impact on W-2 or P60 filing?

ben-payroll: They'll get a corrected payslip and we will issue a W-2 adjustment if any US wages were reported. If they become non-resident for US purposes, we may need to file a W-2c. For UK side we'll include PAYE on their P60. I'll loop in tax counsel if amounts > $2k. @marta can you confirm evidence threshold?

marta: Yep — evidence required: UK address + visa + starter checklist. If refund > £1,500 escalate to tax counsel. Also flag for payroll audit trail.

Sam-employee: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick fix. Let me know if you need any extra paperwork.

ben-payroll: will follow up in ticket PR-4821 with screenshots and the payslip update. cc @ana

Ana: awesome, thanks :thumbsup:
